title: Travel Completed | EU 261 (UK) | Controllable | Delay 3�<4 hrs | Sister City | Cash | Single Pax | 1 Leg | No Changes
goal: UK-origin flight diverted to sister-city airport YTZ (Toronto City/Billy Bishop) instead of YYZ (Toronto Pearson). 3.5hr delay, controllable. Sister City flag = TRUE. Validates: (1) Sister city pairing (YYZ?YTZ) works under EU 261 UK regime, (2) Delay calculated as actual arrival at YTZ minus promised arrival at YYZ (sister city accepted as equivalent), (3) EU-UK EL-03 code specifically for UK + Sister City combination at Tier 1.
